title: Get a permit to run a function or event on council property
what: Get the council's permit before running a function or entertainment event on council property or another public place.

laws.title: City of Stirling Local Government Property Local Law 2009

sources.title: City of Stirling Local Government Property Local Law 2009
sources.locator: cl 3.13(1)(h), as made, Gazette No. 97, 5 Jun 2009
sources.quote: A person must not without a permit—

sources.title: City of Stirling Local Government Property Local Law 2009
sources.locator: cl 3.13(1)(h), as made, Gazette No. 97, 5 Jun 2009
sources.quote: conduct a function, or undertake any promotional activity, on local government property

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. Amended later (Gazette No. 182, 30 Sep 2011, Gazette No. 146, 12 Aug 2016, Gazette No. 94, 28 Jul 2026); the amendments were not read.

assessment.summary: Events on council property need the council's permit.
